APP.TITLE: Local Leads
APP.SUBTITLE: Find local businesses by locality and spot the ones missing contact data.
NAV.LABEL: Main navigation
HOME.LEAD: Search any locality, list its local businesses with their phone, email, website and address, and instantly spot the ones that still need an online presence.
HOME.ZOOM_TEXT: From the whole planet to the streets of {{place}}: type a place, pick a radius and the app maps every shop, restaurant and office around it.
HOME.ZOOM_TEXT_NEARBY: From the whole planet to the streets around you: type a place, pick a radius and the app maps every shop, restaurant and office around it.
HOME.LEADS_TITLE: Spot who is missing contact data
HOME.LEADS_TEXT: Each business comes with the data you would copy from Google Maps. Filter the ones without a mobile, email or website — they are your best leads.
HOME.HOW_TITLE: From a place name to a list of qualified leads in three steps
HOME.STEP_1_TEXT: Type a town or city, choose the radius and the kinds of businesses you want to reach.
HOME.STEP_2_TEXT: Keep the businesses without a phone, mobile, email or website — the ones that need your services.
HOME.STEP_3_TEXT: Export the list to CSV today. Automatic emails with your own templates are coming next.
HOME.FEATURES_TITLE: Everything you need to prospect locally
HOME.FEATURE_SOURCES_TEXT: OpenStreetMap out of the box and free; Google Places when you add an API key.
HOME.FEATURE_FILTERS_TEXT: No phone, no mobile, no email, no website or no data at all — combined as you need.
HOME.FEATURE_MOBILE_TEXT: Portuguese mobile numbers are tagged so you know who you can text.
HOME.FEATURE_EXPORT_TEXT: Download the filtered list, ready for Excel, your CRM or a mailing tool.
HOME.FEATURE_I18N_TEXT: Switch the interface language at any time from the top bar.
HOME.FEATURE_EMAIL_TEXT: Send personalised emails to your leads in bulk, straight from the app.
HOME.CTA_TITLE: Ready to find your next client?
HOME.CTA_TEXT: Start with your own town — it takes less than a minute.
SEARCH.LOADING: Looking for businesses, this can take a few seconds…

SEARCH.PAGE_SUBTITLE: Choose a locality, pick the business categories and filter the ones missing a phone, email or website.
